limitations: Display context only; does not change routing measurements or calibration.
Background outside the supplied borough land polygons represents water within display_bbox only.
Basemap roads include nonwalkable context; the route engine separately filters walkability.
Park polygons and labels do not verify current public access, entrances, or opening hours.
Building placeholders and polygon parts smaller than 4 square metres are omitted for legibility.
